correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the relaxed matroid using binary Fano labels and checked basis exchange. Standard matroid subset inequalities give an exhaustive list of candidates. The fresh exact reproduction (python3 reproduction_4.py) selects dimension-five equality faces and closes the resulting 20 facets under nonempty intersection. Its face vector is (29,138,263,242,108,20,1); it certifies saturation via maximal minors for all 800 nonzero normal cones and counts nonsimplicial cones by face dimension as (29,120,111,18). The inclusion-maximal faces among those 278 are 18 lattice tetrahedra, 24 lattice triangles, 15 lattice parallelograms and the sole vertex 012, with face-edge lattice bases checked. Smoothness and Q-factoriality therefore fail on precisely the same orbits. The maximal cones' sole integral relation has unit coefficients and sign sizes (2,2), (2,3), (2,3), (3,4); saturation identifies their dual monoids with nonnegative integer pairs of equal total, not a finite quotient of those monoids. The saturated cone lattice splits off the dense orbit torus. This gives the Segre germs and multiplicities binomial(a+b-2,a-1)=2,3,3,10. The condition for a rational height-one functional on all rays is exactly a=b; there it is integral and gives Gorensteinness (normal affine toric rings are Cohen–Macaulay). The isolated closed orbit is in no positive-dimensional component. This checks reduced support and generic transverse types, not scheme structures or nongeneric local rings.
residual_risks: Uses standard matroid base polytope, toric orbit/cone, and normal affine semigroup results; no claim of formal verification.
